_meta.purpose: Tranche 3 (tranche/3) branch protection ruleset, source-of-truth artifact. Operator must apply this to GitHub via either the Rulesets API or the web admin -- this file alone is not enforced automatically. See README.md in this directory for the apply path.
_meta.mirrors_doctrine: devops/tranche-branch-governance + devops/worktree-and-branch-hygiene (slice work pushes directly to tranche/3 per operator decision 2026-07-06; PR-required only at develop and higher)

rules._note: GPG signing not enabled by default. Enable separately if/when operator wants signed-tranche policy. Left false here to match the develop baseline.

Pull-request reviews are explicitly NOT required on tranche/3 -- slices push directly per operator decision 2026-07-06. The promotion PR (tranche/3 -> develop) is governed by the develop-side ruleset, not this one.

required_status_checks._note: Primary push-time gate on tranche/3. Fires from .github/workflows/tranche-3-ci.yml on every push to tranche/3 (no path filter). Run cargo test + npm typecheck + npm test.

Manifest + release-notes validator. Fires from both push and pull_request triggers under .github/workflows/tranche-3-ci.yml (the job is no longer gated to pull_request-only). Runs tools/release/check_release_manifest.py against any touched manifest.yaml or release-notes.md under docs/release/... (relocated 2026-07-20; programs/codex/requirements/ no longer holds any of this).

rules._note: Restrict pushes to a list of actor ids. Operators should fill in their actual maintainer github user ids here. Names/slack handles are documentation; the API requires numeric ids.
Branch exists already; creation blocked is irrelevant until the branch is deleted/recreated.
If the operator wants to allow specific actors to bypass the rules above (e.g. an autofix workflow bot), populate push_actors in the restrict_pushes rule and/or add them here. By default no bypass.
